sections.bodyString:
Ready-to-eat straight outta’ the bag! Honey Smoked Salmon® is fresh, never frozen – meaning our sustainably sourced salmon is ready to enjoy within days after being caught. Food this nutritious isn’t supposed to be crazy flavorful; any kale or broccoli fans? Swimming in good-for-you stuff like Omega-3’s, protein, and Vitamin D, you can feel good about adding Honey Smoked Salmon® to any meal or snack.

We’re not one to share our secrets, but we’ll let you in on one – it’s our small batch smoking process that really seals the deal. After marinating for 90 minutes, our salmon spends a toasty five hours smoking over hardwood hickory chips locking in our signature Honey Smoked flavor.
All that sound good? We think so too. That’s why we’re passionate about our Honey Smoked Salmon®. Try it once, and you’ll be hooked! Pun intended.

sections.bodyString: ARM & HAMMER Baking Soda is the essential, do-it-all staple that’s built for both everyday life and bigger jobs. This multi-purpose baking soda helps keep your home ready for anything—from brightening laundry and freshening carpets to scrubbing sinks and reducing tough odors without harsh chemicals. Its fine texture powers countless cleaning and DIY projects around the home. ARM & HAMMER Baking Soda is proudly made in the USA. This versatile baking soda reflects a more conscious lifestyle, helping you cook, clean, create, and care for your home or business with a single trusted ingredient.
Sodium Bicarbonate

While Fresh-N-Natural contains pure ARM & HAMMER™ Baking Soda, we do not recommend it for baking as the granulation is designed specifically for deodorizing. After use, pour down the drain while running warm water to freshen.

Directions: Add 1/2 teaspoon to 1/2 glass (4 fl. oz.) of water every 2 hours, or as directed by physician. Dissolve completely in water. Accurately measure 1/2 teaspoon. Do not take more than the following amounts in 24 hours: seven 1/2 teaspoons; three 1/2 teaspoons if you are over 60 years. Do not use the maximum dosage for more than 2 weeks. How to Use: For those who monitor pH only. Every week during the swimming pool season , measure the pH and Arm & Hammer baking soda as indicated below: If pH is: Less than 7.2; Add per 10,000 gallons of water: 3-4 lbs. If pH is: Between 7.2 - 7.5; Add per 10,000 gallons of water: 2 lbs. If pH is: Above 7.5; Add per 10,000 gallons of water: Don't add Baking Soda. To prevent clouding, especially in hard water areas (250 ppm or more) or when using a calcium chlorinating agent, keep the pH below 7.8 by adding sodium bisulfate or acid if necessary. For Those Who Monitor Both pH and Alkalinity: Pool professionals advise that Baking Soda (sodium bicarbonate) be used to provide alkalinity (proper range 80-100 ppm), and that alkalinity and pH be controlled independently. Every week during the season, measure the alkalinity and add Arm & Hammer Baking Soda as indicated below: If Alkalinity is: 20 ppm; Add per 10,000 gallons of water: 12 lbs. If Alkalinity is: 40 ppm; Add per 10,000 gallons of water: 9 lbs. If Alkalinity is: 60 ppm; Add per 10,000 gallons of water: 6 lbs. If Alkalinity is: 80 ppm; Add per 10,000 gallons of water: 3 lbs. If Alkalinity is: 110 ppm or higher; Add per 10,000 gallons of water: Don't add baking soda. By controlling alkalinity at the proper range of 80-100 ppm, the pH will usually stabilize in its desired range. However, occasional pH adjustment may be necessary. Therefore, pH also should be measured every week. If pH is high, add sodium bisulfate or acid in moderation to reduce pH. If pH is low, but the alkalinity is in the proper range, don't add baking soda (sodium bicarbonate). Adjust pH by adding a chemical with high pH such as soda ash (sodium carbonate) to raise pH rapidly without significantly increasing alkalinity. Storage and Disposal: Visit www.terracycle.com/armandhammer-oxiclean to learn how to recycle through Terracycle. Otherwise, place empty bag in trash collection. Store in dry area in closed, original container.
